evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies the HTTP server in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
rationale: Prevents Windows from issuing a TCP reset during HTTP parse or size errors (issue #35632), ensuring clients receive proper 400 and 413 error replies instead of aborted connections. It also resolves a recurring burden of flaky functional test failures, with reviewers confirming concept support for lingering close to improve test determinism and client politeness.
